intro: Yorik keeps at it until the reply arrives, and asks you before every reminder.
switchedOffForYou: Pipelines are turned off for you. Your parents or an admin can turn them back on.

firstSteps.step1Text: a cancellation, request or demand you sent
firstSteps.step2Text: Yorik suggests reminders; you adjust the days and texts and approve each one
firstSteps.step3Text: it looks for the reply in all your mail, even from other addresses, and asks you before every reminder
firstSteps.recentlySent: Recently sent — which one should Yorik track?
firstSteps.noSentMails: No sent emails in Yorik yet. Write one in Mail and it will show up here.

people.title: Who can use pipelines
people.explain: On for everyone. Turning it off pauses that person's running pipelines; it doesn't let you see what's in them.
people.adminOnly: only an admin can change this

attention.kann_nicht_pruefen: Yorik can't check reliably right now
attention.uebergabe: No reply after all the reminders
attention.versand_unklar: Not sure whether the reminder went out
attention.person_aus: Pipelines are turned off for you

detail.draftingText: It reads your email, works out what reply you're expecting, and suggests timing and texts. This usually takes less than a minute.
detail.redraftConfirm: Yorik will rewrite the open reminders; your changes and approvals on them will be lost. Continue?
detail.startText: From now on Yorik watches for the reply. When a reminder is due, it asks you first; nothing goes out without your okay.

step.handoverNote: If no reply has come by then, Yorik will let you know.
step.subject: Subject
step.showQuote: Your first email is quoted underneath

source.llm: Written by Yorik. When it's due, Yorik rewrites it once more so it's up to date.
source.llm_frisch: Rewritten by Yorik today, with everything that has happened since.
source.vorlage: Only a template: the language model couldn't be reached. “Let Yorik rewrite” tries again.

attn.maybeText_one: This email could be the reply. Until you decide, no reminder goes out.
attn.maybeText_other: These emails could be the reply. Until you decide, no reminder goes out.
attn.rewrittenToday: Yorik has rewritten the reminder for today.
attn.editBelow: You can change the text further down in the steps.
attn.checksBeforeSending: Yorik checks once more right before sending.
attn.cantCheckText: As long as Yorik can't see your mail reliably, it won't send any reminder. It tries again every 15 minutes.
attn.handoverText: All reminders have gone out and no reply has come. What next?
attn.selfRepliedText: You wrote to the other side yourself:
attn.checkSentFolder: Look in your mailbox under “Sent”. Yorik won't send anything again until you tell it.
attn.personOffText: Pipelines are turned off for you; this one waits until they're back on.

features.title: How Yorik recognises the reply
features.scope: Yorik searches all your mailboxes, including spam, since {{date}}. Any email that matches this is shown to you before Yorik sends a reminder.

domains.label: Domains
domains.hint: any address at this domain counts

window.title: Sending times · {{days}}, {{from}}:00–{{to}}:00
window.note: Outside these hours Yorik doesn't ask about sending; it waits.
